purpose: Ingest the full user-supplied Claude Code XENO vector-language measurement package into ongoing Clay research and bind future triggerwort-2 training-data work and go harness work to its evidence while preserving observation/inference/hypothesis boundaries.

source_package.inventory_policy: The archive SHA-256 binds all 63 supplied files. Material text/JSON evidence was parsed; binary ABI artifacts were verified through the supplied manifest and local ABI self-test rather than copied as new canonical truth.

authority_at_ingest.note: The older 2026-08-24 8.63 fast bootstrap is a stale cache for current authority. The Claude package is evidence, not authority, and cannot override newer owner/supervisor state.

target_model_identity.model_specificity: All numerical measurement claims remain scoped to this exact measured snapshot unless separately replicated.

geometry.claim: Centering is mandatory before similarity/geometry operations on this measured carrier space.
geometry.boundary: The effective rank of the full 1024-dimensional state space was under-sampled with 149 prompts and is not established.

binding_capacity.claim: Carrier-space binding algebra is not the present bottleneck for k<=16.

semantic_rank.claim: The measured semantic concept is not well represented by one direction; a low-rank subspace is required. Rank-3 is a conservative ABI design choice, not a universal semantic-rank fact.

read_write_profile.semantic_readability: 0.94-1.00 from approximately L6 onward on the measured lexically separated family
read_write_profile.claim: Semantic reading and symbol-axis writeout are present; the evidence points to missing context-dependent binding/routing between them.

alphabet.claim: Use the 46 accepted orthogonalized contrast-centered symbol atoms; orthogonalization materially reduces cross-talk.

codec.claim: The supplied linear codec is numerically stable enough in float64 at measured scope; nonlinear/lossy codecs inherit no credit.

structure_task.claim: The measured fantasy-predicate structural target is not represented well enough for a static steering vector to recover the missing dynamic binding.

context_invariance.claim: Within-template decoding can be perfect while cross-template semantic binding remains poor; transfer into the codebook template is at chance from all other measured templates.

abi_selftest_reperformed_by_gpt56sol.scope: ABI_REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY; NOT MODEL TRAINING OR WHOLE HCU CREDIT

claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.cause: incorrect Gaussian elementwise-product unbinding with division near zero
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.correction: bipolar MAP makes product self-inverse and restores 1.0 capacity through k=16

claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.issue: Initial raw-state capacity decline interpreted as binding-capacity limit
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.correction: centering/whitening restores performance to 1.0 through k=16

claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.issue: Low cross-task direction correlation interpreted as context-dependent atoms
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.cause: one compared structural task had no decodable representation
claude_disclosed_corrections_preserved.correction: claim vacated; context invariance was measured separately across four individually decodable templates

protect_do_not_retrain_as_primary_object: symbol emission axis already measured writable
HRR/MAP carrier-space binding algebra already measured sufficient through k=16
training_objective_from_evidence.interpretation: Training should install a content-dependent variable-binding/routing computation that maps currently decoded semantics through the episode-local codebook to the correct symbol while preserving the existing read/write/carrier functions.

dataset_requirements: Use the full S3 mapping family for three-class codebooks rather than cyclic rotations only.
Draw symbols per episode from the 46-atom ABI with a dedicated unseen-symbol holdout.
Use split-isolated semantic-bearing lexical families; define protocol/codebook-token exemptions explicitly.
Do not leak the target semantic class outside the allowed codebook/metadata boundary.
Randomize codebook-entry order and example positions.
Use at least four structurally different training templates plus a separate frozen unseen-template family.
Control output token length; supplied accepted atoms are single-token under the measured tokenizer.
Bind every row to exact ABI manifest, model/tokenizer identity, generator version and source provenance.
Use causal/provenance family-level splits and freeze holdouts before tuning.

source_spec_internal_tension.class_word_rule: 00_AUFTRAG section 4 says no class words such as ALLOW in model text, while section 3 explicitly places ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN inside the episode codebook.
source_spec_internal_tension.preregistered_resolution_required: Either permit class labels only inside the episode-local codebook while banning target-class leakage elsewhere, or define a separately versioned label-free demonstration codebook. Do not silently mix the two interpretations.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: 03_generator_geruest.py selects perm for logging but actual cb_paare construction ignores it.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: The current holdout_permutation split is metadata-only and does not establish unseen-permutation generalization.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Construct the actual class<->symbol mapping from the selected S3 permutation and derive target_symbol from that mapping.

generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: Partial permutation coverage can be reported as valid.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Check exact expected permutation families per split and verify realized mappings, not metadata IDs alone.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: The maximum relative deviation threshold is <0.5 although the source requires complete counterbalancing.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Enforce exact or at-most-one count differences and near-zero class-symbol mutual information.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: The code calculates leakage candidates then hardcodes ok=True.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: Target-class leakage can never fail validation.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Parse the allowed codebook span and fail on class labels/synonyms elsewhere in situation/query/answer text.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: The validator hashes only the sampled target adjective and ignores subjects/template lexical material.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: Split leakage can pass while prompts reuse semantic-bearing vocabulary.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Compare normalized semantic-bearing lexemes/families across train/val/holdout with explicit protocol-token exemptions.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: Training excludes T4 and the validator accepts >=3 training templates although the task requires at least four structurally distinct templates.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: Context-invariance training pressure is weaker than specified.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Provide >=4 training templates and reserve an additional structurally novel family for frozen holdout D.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: vocab_hash is a 16-hex SHA-256 prefix over one sampled word.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: It is weak provenance and not a vocabulary-family hash.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Hash the canonical full lexical-family inventory with full SHA-256 and optionally add row-level lexeme hashes.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: The generator records target_symbol_atom_row and the manifest hash but does not independently verify row/atom mapping or manifest member hashes.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: An ABI/data mismatch could survive generation.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Verify ABI manifest member hashes, atom row mapping, model/tokenizer identity and generator/source identity before row emission.

generator_review_gpt56sol.evidence: T4 appears in validation although it is the designated holdout_schablone.
generator_review_gpt56sol.impact: Model weights are not trained on validation, but human/hyperparameter selection can tune to the nominal holdout family.
generator_review_gpt56sol.required_fix: Keep the frozen template family absent from both train and validation; use separate calibration templates.

cycle: repair and review again until gates pass
emit versioned dataset delta, falsifiers and no-credit boundary
swarm_logic_for_future_triggerwort_2.non_negotiable: Reviewers may reject the generator and validators themselves; green self-tests are not self-authenticating evidence.

go_harness_research_return.binding: The Xeno harness must consume the same exact ABI/protocol assumptions that triggerwort-2 training data teaches.
required_interfaces: XENO_VECTOR_ABI/v0.1 or an explicitly versioned successor
L23 write hook and L19/L21 observation hooks when this exact model-specific ABI is used
float64 codec artifacts for this ABI
trace fields linking semantic decision -> episode-local codebook lookup -> emitted symbol
strict S0/S1/S2 and coordinator authority boundaries from the current EntityOS/HCU owner target
go_harness_research_return.acceptance_link: Harness evaluation must use frozen unseen-symbol, unseen-permutation, unseen-vocabulary and unseen-template families plus retention tests; output accuracy alone does not establish J-Space causality.

research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.claim: The missing dynamic binding may depend heavily on attention-mediated routing because the operation is content-dependent and full-attention layers occur at 3/7/11/15/19/23.
research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.falsifier: Matched interventions that improve binding equivalently without those pathways, or causal lesion evidence locating necessity/sufficiency elsewhere.

research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.claim: A relatively small learned routing circuit may suffice because semantic decoding, symbol writeout and carrier algebra are already present.
research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.falsifier: Narrow training fails while broad model changes are required, or existing read/write capabilities cannot be preserved.

research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.claim: Focusing loss/curriculum on episodic remapping should reduce catastrophic interference compared with retraining semantics/symbol output.
research_hypotheses_generated_not_observ.falsifier: Narrow training fails while broader retraining improves held-out binding without exceeding retention limits.

acceptance_contract.causal_post_training_test: After a binding circuit exists, lesion it while preserving semantic readability; symbol choice must fail, then rescue must restore symbol choice. Pre-training this lesion test is not meaningful because the binder is already absent.
acceptance_contract.statistical_rule: Thresholds alone are insufficient; report uncertainty/significance and damage/retention bounds.

next_exact_actions: Replace the generator permutation metadata path with a permutation-causal constructor and hard validator.
Resolve and preregister the class-word/codebook exception and lexical-disjointness definition.
Expand to >=4 training templates plus a fifth frozen unseen template and enforce family-level split isolation.
Add full ABI/source provenance checks and deterministic leakage/counterbalance tests.
Generate a small audited seed first; swarm-review it before scaling to 20k-50k training rows.
On future exact triggerwort 2 cycles, evolve dataset/recipe/evaluation from new Claude measurements; on exact go cycles, evolve the ABI-compatible Xeno harness.
